description: Returns one saved file from a website with its path, encoding and content: pages, stylesheets and scripts as utf8 text, pictures and fonts as base64. It changes nothing. A path that is not saved fails with no_such_file; list_website_files shows which paths exist.

editKey.description: The editKey start_website returned, which proves the website is the caller's. Leave it out for a website in the connected account.

path.description: The file's path from the website's root, exactly as it was saved, such as index.html, about.html or images/shop.jpg. list_website_files shows every path.

websiteId.description: The websiteId start_website returned, or one list_sites shows.

name: read_website_file
title: Read a website file
